verdict.rationale: Together documents throughput-oriented serving: dedicated endpoints on reserved hardware with "better performance" and no hard rate limits, provisioned throughput units with committed throughput targets, replica autoscaling, and SSE streaming. One community user also reports "good speed." Nothing in the evidence addresses time-to-first-token or latency targets, so the latency-sensitive half of the story is only implied. missing for 10: documented TTFT or latency targets or benchmarks, published tokens/sec figures, independent hands-on latency corroboration.
